newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Inchcape unit expands into the Philippines.
newsitem.headline: Inchcape unit expands into the Philippines.

text.p: Office automation equipment distributor Inchcape NRG said on Thursday it has expanded into a tenth regional market with the launch of direct operations in the Philippines.

Inchcape NRG is a 50/50 percent joint venture between Ricoh Co Ltd and Inchcape Plc, and has direct operations in Hong Kong, China, Macau, Taiwan, Singapore, Malaysia, Thailand, Australia and New Zealand and exports to regional markets like Indonesia, Vietnam and Myanmar.
The new operation, Inchcape NRG (Philippines) Inc, is the exclusive distributor in the Philippines of Ricoh and Gestetner brand products.
